_: The eighteen-lane bowling alley (brief addendum D4, D5; Shared/Attractions/AlleyLayout). Local to world: x = 1300 + X, y = 16.5 + Y, z = -420 - D; eye height is the floor + 5.2. Render: lune run tools/review/export.luau --out build/review_alley/scene.json; then render.py --scene build/review_alley/scene.json --views tools/review/views_alley.json --out build/review_alley. The labelled plan is tools/review/alley_plan.luau + alley_plan.py. Committed pictures: docs/renders/alley18/.
